title: Survey Column
description: A freestanding tapered 18 m limestone column with fluted drums, a weathered plinth, and an overhanging capital.

review.notes: Round 2. Fixed: the grey mottling is gone, flutes are now cut in with fillets, drum heights vary, the capital has an echinus and abacus. Not fixed: (1) there are still no chips, cracks or broken edges anywhere on the shaft or base (round-1 point 2). (2) At the drum joints the flute edges wobble and misalign, so the seams look lumpy instead of crisp; the shaft silhouette shows its polygon facets. (3) The capital is thin and plain for an 18 m column; add a neck ring and a deeper echinus profile. (4) The surface is a uniform sandpaper grain with no local weathering at the base, joints or weather side.
